name: How long does it typically take to sell an expired luxury listing after re-marketing?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to sell an expired luxury listing after re-marketing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for selling an expired luxury listing after re-marketing varies significantly based on market conditions, pricing adjustments, property presentation, and marketing reach. While there's no guaranteed timeframe, a well-executed re-marketing strategy aims to reduce market time compared to the previous attempt. Timing can also depend on specific local market dynamics within our service areas like Miami-Dade, Broward, or Palm Beach County, where buyer demand fluctuates.
acceptedAnswer.description: The sales timeline varies significantly based on market conditions, pricing, presentation, and marketing reach, with a good strategy aiming to reduce market time.
